title: rail-hardness-row
description: RLAIHF joint row for environment-design gradient-health. One row per RAIL (a decision-fork an agent faces). Objective axes (formation/observability/payoff/hook_backed) are AI/GECKO-captured; operator_stamp is the subjective lane (does the governed path FEEL like the path of least resistance). The join is the substrate. See grimoires/loa/context/2026-06-07-environment-design-game-theory-synthesis.md.

formation.description: objective: can the game FORM? players registered/present/connected (1) or not (0)

observability.description: objective: is the cooperative move VISIBLE via an un-fakeable artifact (1) or not (0)

payoff_regime.description: objective: the ACTUAL equilibrium today (soft = intentionally unenforced / judgment)

intended_regime.description: the TARGET regime this rail SHOULD be in. soft = judgment-seam (must stay soft); stick = safety/integrity gate; 3-3 = compounding rail. Alignment = actual achieves intended. 100% = 100% ALIGNED, never 100% hardened.

hook_backed.description: objective: is hardness a PreToolUse hook / un-fakeable artifact (true) or SKILL.md prose (false)? = the roleplay-vulnerability test

hook_path.description: for hook_backed rails: the path to the hook/artifact. The scanner VERIFIES it exists — hook_backed is a claim that must resolve to a real file (un-fakeable).

operator_stamp.description: subjective lane (RLAIHF): the operator's felt read — sticky, optional

feels_default.description: does the GOVERNED path feel like the path of least resistance here?

altitude.description: optional: which layer of the stack the fork lives at — 1 operator (~/.claude) · 2 hooks/settings · 3 loa-harness (skills/protocols) · 4 repo (CLAUDE.md/workflows walls) · 5 CI+evals (the measurement layer)

rail_or_seam.description: optional: rail = deterministic transport (hardenable); seam = judgment fork (must stay soft — hardening it is the OVER-WALLED failure)

gap_class.description: optional: the roleplay-vulnerability class — PROSE-WALL = stick intent enforced only by prose; GHOST-HOOK = hook exists but does not fire (unwired/blind/fails-open); OVER-WALLED = a judgment seam wrongly gated; NONE = healthy

severity.description: optional: CONFLICT = the map claims teeth the territory lacks (load-bearing wall); SMELL = misalignment worth tracking, map roughly honest

evidence.description: optional: grounded file:line evidence for the scoring — what was actually read/verified, not inferred
